name: SegmentedControl

props.name: label
props.description: Names the choice, never an option: "Colour scheme". The group's accessible name.

props.name: options
props.description: Two to five exclusive options, in a meaningful order.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The new choice. It applies at once and isn't saved, so there's no pending state.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Shows only each option's icon, for a compact choice the icons make recognisable; each label becomes its tooltip and accessible name.

props.name: size
props.description: The Button size scale (xs 24, s 36, normal 44, m 48, l 56, xl 64, xxl 80 px segments). `s` (default) on dense surfaces such as an app title bar; `xs` inside content, such as a toolbar over a preview; `normal` and up in forms and settings, beside Buttons of the same size.

props.name: disabled
props.description: The choice can't change here. Prefer saying why nearby.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: How the chosen segment shows: `accent` (default) an accent fill with on-accent text; `raised` a raised surface with accent text, for a mode switch that sits beside an accent-filled choice (a design tool's Design and Dev mode beside its tools).

props.name: track
props.description: The group's own track (fill and outline). Turn it off where a surrounding bar already encloses the segments (a floating tool bar): one enclosure per boundary.

props.name: value
props.description: What `onChange` receives when this option is chosen.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the option in sentence case. Shown, or its accessible name and tooltip when `iconOnly`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon from the active set; required when `iconOnly`.
